data.Name: Wellbore-IndexPropertyPathConfiguration
data.Description: The index property list for master-data--Wellbore:1., valid for all master-data--Wellbore kinds for major version 1.

Configurations.Name: SpudDate
Configurations.UseCase: As a user I want to discover and match or sort Wellbores by their spud date. I am aware that there are nuances, however, I am able to satisfied to query on a single FacilityEventType to look up value in the FacilityEvents array.

Configurations.Name: WellUWI
Configurations.UseCase: As a user I want to discover and match Wellbores by their parent's UWI. I am aware that this is not globally reliable, however, I have arrived at a reasonable UWI selection at the parent Well.

Configurations.Name: WellLogCurveMnemonics
Configurations.UseCase: As a user I want to find Wellbores by well log mnemonics.
